Parse Hive DDL without recovery

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::process;

fn main() {
    let source = r#"CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE t(`a` string, `b` array<string>)
PARTITIONED BY (`p` string)
ROW FORMAT SERDE 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.ParquetHiveSerDe'
STORED AS INPUTFORMAT 'x' OUTPUTFORMAT 'y'
LOCATION 's3://{{bucket}}/t/'
TBLPROPERTIES ('k'='v');"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"language":"sql"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = process(source, &config).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.language);
    println!("{:?}", result.metrics.error_count);
    println!("{:?}", result.metrics.total_bytes);
    println!("{:?}", result.structure);
    println!("{:?}", result.structure[0].name);
}
```
